# defectdojo_product_origin (Resource)

Manages an entry of DefectDojo's product origins, the values of a product's `origin`. DefectDojo comes with `third party library`, `purchased`, `contractor`, `internal`, `open source` and `outsourced`. Managing them needs a superuser or a staff user: they have no configuration permissions that `defectdojo_user` could grant.

-> DefectDojo can't change `value`, so changing it replaces the entry, and DefectDojo refuses to delete an entry that products use. Set `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }` so that the new entry is created, and the products move to it, before the old one is deleted. With `create_before_destroy`, `terraform apply -replace` fails, since the new entry would have the same value as the old one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "defectdojo_product_origin" "acquired" {
  value         = "acquired"
  name          = "Acquired company"
  icon          = "building"
  display_order = 70

  # DefectDojo can't change the value, and refuses to delete an entry that
  # products use: create the new entry before deleting the old one.
  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "defectdojo_product" "example" {
  name            = "Example"
  description     = "An example product"
  product_type_id = 4
  origin          = defectdojo_product_origin.acquired.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The label DefectDojo's UI shows. At most 200 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.
- `value` (String) The value that products use in `origin`, at most 50 characters, unique among the product origins, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes. DefectDojo can't change it, so changing it replaces the entry; see the note on `create_before_destroy`.

### Optional

- `display_order` (Number) The position in the UI's lists, lower first, a 32-bit integer. Defaults to `0`.
- `icon` (String) A Font Awesome icon class for the classic UI, such as `desktop`, at most 100 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the product origin.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = defectdojo_product_origin.example
  identity = {
    id = 6
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the product origin

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Product origins are imported by their numeric ID
terraform import defectdojo_product_origin.example <id>
```
